title: Louis-CFM/coucou
why_read: A lightweight cross-platform menu bar widget that monitors AI coding agents, a nice-to-have utility rather than a significant technical contribution.
analysis: Coucou is a small native app that sits in your macOS notch or top-of-screen area on Windows/Linux and shows the status of AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It's a convenience and ambient-awareness tool rather than something that introduces new techniques, but it's a sign of growing tooling built around managing multiple concurrent AI coding agents. Worth a glance for developers juggling several AI assistants at once, but not deeply technical.
